_help: bootloader_size: bytes protected for the bootloader (BOOTPROT). app_offset: where a .bin firmware is written.
bootloader: path to the D9.4.1 bootloader file. Leave empty to use the first .bin/.hex/.elf in bootloader/.
firmware: leave empty to use the first file in firmware/, or download Stable/Development builds in the app.
release_repo + *_asset (regex): which GitHub release files are the firmware and bootloader for this board.
